records.actual_reading_scope: All eight original PMC page scans visually read, including Methods, strain/plasmid Table1, Figures1–5, results and discussion; reference list inspected as context.
records.assessment: ADP1/BD413 qui gene deletions disrupt growth on both shikimate and quinate. Figure1 distinguishes two-step shikimate from three-step quinate. QuiA first-step identity has native genetic support; membrane/PQQ family and five helices involve sequence inference. Heterologous expression was not directly measurable. No purified ADP1 kinetic constants are established.

records.actual_reading_scope: Author-rendered methods, cloning/catalysis results, Table1 and relevant figure captions read. Original 1995 figure rasters unavailable. Captures contain later web boilerplate, not all of which is source text.
records.assessment: QuiC pZR564 E.coli crude extract tested DHS-to-PCA catalysis with truncated negative control. Preserve experimental construct/preparation; no homogeneous purification. Native MONOMER37 DHQ/unit wording is not supported by the decisive assay. QuiX transport substrate and precise periplasm localization remain unsettled.

records.actual_reading_scope: Author reprint ChapterV PDF90–102 text read; PDF94,96,98 (printed85,87,89) visually inspected for Table1, nonpurification and assumed topology; title/publications identification text PDF9 read. Other chapters not reviewed.
records.assessment: LMD79.41 is historically assigned A.calcoaceticus by API20NE; do not silently equate with ADP1. Shikimate growth and PQQ-deficient rescue support pathway context. QDH was not solubilized/purified; membrane-particle association inferred and periplasmic localization explicitly assumed. Historical discussion of Gox non-growth is not a universal modern isolate claim.

records.actual_reading_scope: Original-derived PDFKit text for pages1,2,4,7,8 read; original rendered page4 visually inspected for exact strain table and purification selection. Other pages/figures not independently reread in this review.
records.assessment: SA1 and AC3 are Acinetobacter purification preparations, not Gox or ADP1. Shikimate specificity, 74% rate and kinetic values from this preparation must not be inherited by ADP1 Q59086. Ubiquinone2 acceptor findings likewise remain preparation-bound.

records.actual_reading_scope: Original-derived text pages1–3,6–7 read; original rendered page6 (journal2129) visually inspected for IFO3244 cytoplasmic fractionation and DHSase separation. Other figures/culture optimization results not independently reread.
records.assessment: Native MONOMER1 retains IFO3244 partially purified cytoplasmic fraction; DHS-to-PCA assay qualitative. No whole-route growth/mineralization inferred from oxidative fermentation or mixed enzyme conversion.

records.actual_reading_scope: Actual EuropePMC primary abstract and metadata reread; no full 2004 body inspection claimed.
records.assessment: IFO3244 QDH is membrane-associated PQQ holoenzyme with possible proteolysis. Abstract does not report explicit shikimate assay; that edge must remain independently attributed to native ENZRXN68 commentary.

records.actual_reading_scope: Original PMC methods, transcript-results sections11–16 and discussion17 read; Tables1–2 and figure captions read. Figures6–7 visually inspected; authoritative HTML/image URLs establish numbering, filenames are not canonical.
records.assessment: PcaU deletion changes qui transcript abundance and inducer dependence. Protocatechuate induces the pca-qui region; quiA probe specific, quiC–quiX probe shared. Constitutive quiAp independent of PcaU persists. Supports expression regulation, not direct binding of PcaU to quiA/quiC promoter or protein activation. Full 14.4kb transcript not directly detected, topology remains hypothesis.

limitations: Scope is exact named pathway evidence, not exhaustive new literature discovery.
No paper results are promoted from a database citation alone.
